result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but there is a significant text-overlap issue in the restaurant listing and some content is visibly clipped at the horizontal and bottom edges.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is visibly overlapping: the delivery-time text collides with the delivery/category line, making the information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the card’s vertical spacing and text wrapping so the delivery time and delivery/category metadata appear on separate, non-overlapping lines.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off at the right edge, with part of the restaurant name and image outside the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional clipping with a visible scroll affordance, or adjust card widths and page padding so the layout does not look accidentally truncated.

issues.description: The next restaurant card near the bottom is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, so its content is cut off by the viewport/navigation area.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the fixed navigation overlays only empty space.
